logline_en: He tugs at a shirt caught in a closed car door. She opens the door before he stretches the problem any further.
logline_tc: 他拉扯被關上的車門夾住的衣角，她先開門，讓他不用再拉。
staging_en: Outside a parked cream car, engine off. One ordinary side door is fully latched and flush CLOSED at the opening. Its hinge is at the front edge; the exterior handle and caught hem are by the trailing edge. The man is screen-left, heroine screen-right by the handle; both bodies stand fully outside the small outward swing path. A broad, intact lower corner of his blue untucked shirt is visibly clamped in the closed trailing seam. His LEFT hand gently holds that same fabric; his RIGHT hand is empty and low. Her RIGHT hand operates the exterior handle. Everyone stays outside.
staging_tc: 停妥的奶油色車外，引擎關閉。開場一扇普通側門已扣上、完全關閉並與車身平齊。鉸鏈在前緣，外把手及被夾衣角在後緣附近。男子在畫面左、女主在畫面右的門把旁，兩人身體均完全避開小幅朝外開門的路徑。他未紮入褲的藍襯衫有一塊寬而完整下角，清楚夾在關閉的後緣門縫。男子左手輕拿同一衣料，右手空著放低；女主右手操作外把手，全員一直在車外。

She looks from snag to handle with a slight eyebrow lift; her RIGHT fingers establish contact on that handle by 3 seconds. Door remains fully shut, hem trapped.

beats.action_en: Only after all cloth and fingers are clear, she gently closes the same panel. RIGHT stays safely on the exterior handle outside the seam, then releases after latching and lowers by 9 seconds. The flush closed door and fully outside intact shirt visibly prove the fix.
beats.action_tc: 所有衣料與手指移開後，女主才輕關同一門片。右手安全留在門縫外的外把手，扣上後才放開，於第9秒前放低。平齊關好的車門與完整留在車外的襯衫，清楚證明問題已解決。

beats.action_tc: 男子放開衣角，雙手在身側停穩，不添加搖頭或拉扯。女主目光留在已解決問題，不延長互望。兩人仍在原位，空手離車身，準備最後合掌。

beats.action_en: She brings both empty flat palms together at lower sternum, eyes soft, and makes one shallow forward bow. Keep the door closed and shirt free. Settle briefly with palms joined after the bow, without adding another action.
beats.action_tc: 女主兩隻空手在胸骨下方平貼合掌、眼神柔和，淺淺前欠一次。門保持關好、衣角自由。欠身後合掌短暫停穩，不再添其他動作。

表演
